description: Default to V2.2 global blend and switch to a fixed expert only when a per-action gain regressor predicts sufficient improvement.
notes: V3.1 does not train a four-way oracle classifier.
For each expert, it regresses expert_NDCG@10 - global_blend_NDCG@10 on validation users.
At test time it keeps global_blend unless the best predicted expert gain exceeds a validation-selected threshold.
Success is measured against V2.2 global_blend.
